assumptions.statement: Official or explicitly rights-cleared SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are unavailable. The repository provisional rough polygons at a57cd13707ea5f65a8701fa3d0924aa2ee35d716 are used as replaceable low-confidence constraints.
assumptions.impact: They support conceptual geometry and recalculation only; all derived layers and artifacts must be replaced when official or rights-cleared geometry appears.

assumptions.statement: site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, and conceptual envelope area are deterministic EPSG:4548 outputs of the submitted provisional design model.
assumptions.impact: They are not official existing-condition values, statutory controls, approved targets, or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage, utilities, fire access, and transport observations remain unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use, development intensity, exact alignments, and engineering conclusions remain data gaps.

assumptions.statement: The buildings layer contains project-authored carrier and project envelopes required to visualise the three spatial rules.
assumptions.impact: It is not an existing-building survey and cannot support building-level retain, adapt, demolish, safety, fire, ownership, or floor-area conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Zhongzhiyuan requires one capacity and adaptability register across existing, under-construction, adaptable, and proposed premises.
assumptions.impact: The proposal does not claim oversupply; it requires ordinary shared functions to use distributed capacity before a new comprehensive centre is justified.

assumptions.statement: AI Origin requires building-level evidence plus verified counts of entrances, short links, courtyard connections, and small user units before and after renewal.
assumptions.impact: Submitted objects are design-test geometry, not a demolition schedule or an observed baseline.

assumptions.statement: Dazhongsi requires a consolidated cross-project, time-based demand record for commuting, events, deliveries, cycling, night use, construction, and public services.
assumptions.impact: The public-ground model expresses a rule for sizing and responsibility, not observed demand or an approved engineering section.

assumptions.statement: Each Dazhongsi public improvement is assigned one conceptual register ID, requires co-delivery where relevant, and retains independent acceptance.
assumptions.impact: No real project contribution, responsibility share, works package, budget, acceptance, completion, or public-benefit credit is claimed.

assumptions.statement: The Doshi-Hauser and Anderson et al. studies support only a limited hypothesis that AI-assisted creative outputs may become less diverse across participants.
assumptions.impact: Neither study is evidence of urban-form convergence or a planning conclusion; Nature model-collapse research is not used as urban-form evidence.

assumptions.statement: The package is built against open-city-ai/haidian at a57cd13707ea5f65a8701fa3d0924aa2ee35d716, verified on 2026-08-28.
assumptions.impact: A later repository state requires a new drift review before any external submission.

assumptions.statement: The 91-point baseline was accepted for repository intake through pull request #4095. This score-lift candidate exists locally only and has not been submitted as a new revision.
assumptions.impact: The builder itself performs no external action. Repository intake does not imply gallery publication, award selection, implementation approval or government endorsement; any new pull request or push requires separate human authorisation.
